mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation models, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contracting housing market, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (base 2017=100) signals manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS above 144 million) consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic momentum builds.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between PAYEMS levels and 60-day SPX returns is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change above 2.5%) triggers expectations of monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High residential investment levels (RSAFS above 450,000 million dollars) indicate robust consumer demand for housing, supporting economic growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between RSAFS levels and 5-day SPX returns is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST below 1150 thousand units) signals weakening residential demand, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1150.
